messages:
Ava: midnight lightchain + tiny-paper-origami table tree challenge! who's up for making a 3-inch tree from office recyclables? winner gets a tiny succulent + bragging rights :tada:
Diego: i'm in. can we use the cardboard from those old monitor boxes? how many people per table?
Priya: love it — count me. i'll bring a glue gun and extra fairy lights. friday 4pm works?
Kai: sign me up. also low-key proposing a 'silent carols' microwave playlist at T-minus glue-time :joy:
ops-bot: Reminder — no open flames or soldering irons in the office. See safety policy: https://intranet/redwood/safety :information_source:
Ava: good call, ops-bot. glue guns ok at own risk but no candles. prize: tiny succulent + $25 e-gift.
Diego: quick poll: react with :one: for Fri 4pm, :two: for Fri 6pm, :three: for Sat noon.
Priya: added a sign-up sheet: https://docs.google.com/example — please add your tabletop theme and whether you want a remote-kit
Kai: :one: for me. i'll run an origami micro-workshop for novices at 4:10pm.
Elena: remote folks — can we have a "desk-tree photo" category? i'll judge remotely and mail a tiny sticker to winners :camera_flash:
Ava: yes to remote category. i'll DM people who want mailed kits — need addresses by Thursday.
Diego: @Priya thanks for the glue gun offer. @ops-bot facilities — any chance we have a stash of tiny LED strings?
Facilities: Facilities: Found a box of micro LEDs in Storage C, plus some leftover fairy lights. We'll put a bin by the front desk on Friday AM along with a stack of cardboard.
Priya: you're a lifesaver, thank you! :pray:
Kai: small request: keep political or divisive themes off the trees. cozy vibes only pls.
Elena: mockup for remote kit posted here: https://imgur.com/placeholder — rustic paper + washi tape idea.
Ava: adorable. also thinking of a tiny hat accessory category. tiny hats for tiny trees.
Diego: are cookies allowed? asking for a friend :cookie:
Priya: cookies yes, vegan option pls. i'll coordinate.
Kai: i'll bring ginger snaps (nut-free batch). anyone allergic to eggs?
Elena: tree submission deadline: Fri 6pm. winners (tabletop & remote) announced Monday morning.
Diego: preemptive kudos to Facilities and Ops for stocking LEDs and cardboard :clap:
ops-bot: Kudos recorded — tagging Facilities. +1 added to the holiday-help leaderboard.
Facilities: Happy to help! Can't wait to see the chaos and creativity :seedling:
Ava: final bit — use hashtags for photo posts: #tiny-tree-2026 #midnight-lightchain. please post a before/after side-by-side and a 1-line caption.
Diego: prototype pic uploaded (placeholder): https://imgur.com/proto1 — i'm not even embarrassed yet.
Priya: will bring extra glue sticks and a tiny first-aid kit for paper cuts.
Kai: see you Friday 4pm. remote folks, slip your photos into this thread when you're ready. good luck, tiny tree engineers! :sparkles:
